ev.q: The Darkness II is a 2012 first-person shooter video game
Jackie can use various firearms, such as submachine guns, shotguns, and assault rifles
can be used to slash enemies or pick up various items within the environment
The player must rescue the soul of Jackie's dead girlfriend, which was trapped by the Darkness in Hell
Jackie is haunted by the memory of his murdered girlfriend
The skill tree is divided into four main aspects
The story received critical acclaim from players
described the cooperative multiplayer mode as a "dark comedy"
Criticisms were directed at the game's short length
which lasted for only seven hours
